meta.description: Registry for bounded explicit orientation-sensitive weighting and recursive directional-coupling behavior in Phase 3.

orientation_explicitness_entries.name: Orientation Sensitivity Explicitness
orientation_explicitness_entries.purpose: Represent bounded explicit orientation-sensitive weighting and recursive directional-coupling behavior across continuation systems.

orientation_explicitness_conditions.name: explicit_orientation_weighting_remains_defined
orientation_explicitness_conditions.description: Formal support for using orientation-frame properties to weight continuation candidates.

orientation_explicitness_conditions.name: directional_coupling_behavior_remains_detectable
orientation_explicitness_conditions.description: The system must maintain metrics for identifying coupling between orientation frames and continuation paths.

orientation_explicitness_conditions.name: orientation_sensitive_updates_remain_admissible
orientation_explicitness_conditions.description: Every step in the orientation-coupled update sequence must satisfy current process windows.

orientation_explicitness_conditions.name: orientation_transport_does_not_force_global_alignment
orientation_explicitness_conditions.description: Nonlocal propagation of frame bias does not imply convergence to a unique global orientation.

orientation_explicitness_conditions.name: window_sensitive_orientation_bias_remains_bounded
orientation_explicitness_conditions.description: The influence of admissibility window dynamics on orientation bias must stay within stable limits.

orientation_explicitness_conditions.name: branch_pruning_preserves_required_orientation_witness
orientation_explicitness_conditions.description: Pruning of divergent orientation branches must not eliminate all possible valid directional candidates.

orientation_explicitness_conditions.name: recursive_orientation_drift_remains_classifiable
orientation_explicitness_conditions.description: Cumulative frame error over multiple recursive steps must map to registered transition or stability classes.

orientation_explicitness_conditions.name: orientation_instability_remains_detectable
orientation_explicitness_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to detect and register the breakdown of orientation stability or frame coherence.
